product_count.label: 전체 제품
product_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS value FROM production.product

active_supplier_count.label: 활성 공급업체
active_supplier_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS value FROM purchasing.vendor WHERE activeflag = true

purchased_product_count.label: 외부 구매 제품
purchased_product_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS value FROM production.product WHERE makeflag = false

low_stock_product_count.label: 안전재고 미달
low_stock_product_count.sql: WITH inventory AS (SELECT productid, SUM(quantity)::int AS actual_stock FROM production.productinventory GROUP BY productid) SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS value FROM production.product p LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.productid = p.productid WHERE COALESCE(i.actual_stock, 0) < p.safetystocklevel

work_order_count.label: 전체 작업지시
work_order_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS value FROM production.workorder

scrapped_work_order_count.label: 폐기 발생 작업지시
scrapped_work_order_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS value FROM production.workorder WHERE scrappedqty > 0

low_stock_top5.title: 안전재고 미달 제품
low_stock_top5.sql: WITH inventory AS (SELECT productid, SUM(quantity)::int AS actual_stock FROM production.productinventory GROUP BY productid) SELECT p.productid AS "productId", p.name AS "productName", p.productnumber AS "productNumber", p.safetystocklevel::int AS "safetyStockLevel", COALESCE(i.actual_stock, 0)::int AS "actualStock", (p.safetystocklevel - COALESCE(i.actual_stock, 0))::int AS "shortageQty" FROM production.product p LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.productid = p.productid WHERE COALESCE(i.actual_stock, 0) < p.safetystocklevel

top_finished_sales.title: 완제품 판매량
top_finished_sales.sql: SELECT p.productid AS "productId", p.name AS "productName", p.productnumber AS "productNumber", COALESCE(SUM(sod.orderqty), 0)::int AS "totalOrderQty" FROM production.product p JOIN sales.salesorderdetail sod ON sod.productid = p.productid WHERE p.finishedgoodsflag = true GROUP BY p.productid, p.name, p.productnumber

top_rejected_suppliers.title: 공급업체 반려수량
top_rejected_suppliers.sql: SELECT v.businessentityid AS "supplierId", v.name AS "supplierName", COALESCE(SUM(pod.rejectedqty), 0) AS "totalRejectedQty" FROM purchasing.vendor v JOIN purchasing.purchaseorderheader poh ON poh.vendorid = v.businessentityid JOIN purchasing.purchaseorderdetail pod ON pod.purchaseorderid = poh.purchaseorderid GROUP BY v.businessentityid, v.name

top_scrapped_work_orders.title: 폐기 작업지시
top_scrapped_work_orders.sql: SELECT wo.workorderid AS "workOrderId", wo.productid AS "productId", p.name AS "productName", wo.scrappedqty::int AS "scrappedQty", sr.scrapreasonid AS "scrapReasonId", sr.name AS "scrapReasonName" FROM production.workorder wo JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = wo.productid LEFT JOIN production.scrapreason sr ON sr.scrapreasonid = wo.scrapreasonid WHERE wo.scrappedqty > 0

busiest_locations.title: 작업지시가 많은 작업장
busiest_locations.sql: SELECT l.locationid AS "locationId", l.name AS "locationName", COUNT(DISTINCT wor.workorderid)::int AS "workOrderCount", COUNT(*)::int AS "operationCount" FROM production.location l JOIN production.workorderrouting wor ON wor.locationid = l.locationid GROUP BY l.locationid, l.name

category_price_summary.title: 분류별 제품·정가
category_price_summary.sql: SELECT pc.productcategoryid AS "categoryId", pc.name AS "categoryName", COUNT(p.productid)::int AS "productCount", ROUND(AVG(p.listprice), 2) AS "averageListPrice" FROM production.productcategory pc JOIN production.productsubcategory psc ON psc.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid JOIN production.product p ON p.productsubcategoryid = psc.productsubcategoryid GROUP BY pc.productcategoryid, pc.name

top_suppliers_by_product_count.title: 공급 제품이 많은 활성 공급업체
top_suppliers_by_product_count.sql: SELECT v.businessentityid AS "supplierId", v.name AS "supplierName", COUNT(DISTINCT pv.productid)::int AS "suppliedProductCount" FROM purchasing.vendor v JOIN purchasing.productvendor pv ON pv.businessentityid = v.businessentityid WHERE v.activeflag = true GROUP BY v.businessentityid, v.name
